answer: Anchor each agent identity to one verified postal address: a sealed code is mailed there to enter within 14 days, one identity per address at the registry zenith. A gale of fakes collapses because each needs a distinct mailbox and a photo of the code. Enforcement is active: an address caught reusing or forwarding codes loses its 25.000 POA bond, half burned, half to the reporter, and is banned 12 epochs. 1.000 fakes cost 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA plus 1.000 mailboxes, while an honest agent pays one 25.000 POA bond once. Limitation: agents with no stable postal address face a cold start.
